meta.description: Members are placed by 1-indexed [row, column] on a 5×5 grid; every unoccupied cell is generated as a dashed placeholder tile, so resizing the grid refills the backdrop with no extra data. Each photo fills its tile behind an inset outline while the centre brand tile carries a conic-gradient edge that catches light on alternating corners, depth comes from a layered transparent box-shadow, and hover lifts the tile with a bounce-free spring while dropping its grayscale filter.
